{{Short description|German biochemist}}
'''Klaus Cichutek''' (born 26 February 1956 in [[Recklinghausen]]) is a German biochemist and the current president of the [[Paul Ehrlich Institute]] (PEI). He is also professor of biochemistry at the [[Goethe University Frankfurt]].

==Early life and education==
Cichutek completed his studies of chemistry in 1981 and earned a doctoral degree in biochemistry in 1984, both at the [[University of Münster]].

==Career==
From 1985 to 1988 Cichutek was affiliated with the Department of Molecular Biology and Virus Laboratory at the [[University of California, Berkeley]]. He has been employed by the Paul Ehrlich Institute since 1988; he became the institute's vice president in 1999 and its president in 2009.<ref>"[https://www.pei.de/DE/infos/presse/pressemitteilungen/archiv-pressemitteilungen/2009/07-bundesgesundheitsminister-roesler-im-paul-ehrlich-institut.html?nn=3250580 Bundesgesundheitsminister Rösler zu Besuch im Paul-Ehrlich-Institut gratuliert Prof. Cichutek zur Ernennung zum Präsidenten des Paul-Ehrlich-Instituts] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130331033430/https://www.pei.de/DE/infos/presse/pressemitteilungen/archiv-pressemitteilungen/2009/07-bundesgesundheitsminister-roesler-im-paul-ehrlich-institut.html?nn=3250580 |date=2013-03-31 }}" (20 November 2009)</ref>

In addition to his role at PEI, Cichutek chaired the [[Bundesärztekammer]]'s commission on [[gene therapy|somatic gene therapy]] from 2000 to 2010, and the Gene Therapy Working Party of the [[European Medicines Agency]] (EMA) from 2003 to 2010.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ema.europa.eu/docs/en_GB/document_library/contacts/kcichutek_CV.pdf|title=Europäische Arzneimittelagentur: Klaus Cichutek|access-date=2020-04-27|archive-date=2016-12-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161220024503/http://www.ema.europa.eu/docs/en_GB/document_library/contacts/kcichutek_CV.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref> Since 2020, he has been an ex-officio member of a working group on [[COVID-19 vaccine]]s established by the [[Strategic Advisory Group of Experts]] at the [[World Health Organization]] (WHO).<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20200710184143/https://www.who.int/immunization/sage/sage_wg_covid-19/en/ SAGE Working Group on Covid-19 vaccines] [[World Health Organization]] (WHO).</ref>

==Awards==
* 2024 Officer's Cross of the [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]]<ref name="Der Bundespräsident h006">{{cite web | title=Verleihung des Verdienstordens der Bundesrepublik Deutschland an Klaus Cichutek und Lothar Wieler | website=Der Bundespräsident | url=https://www.bundespraesident.de/SharedDocs/Reden/DE/Frank-Walter-Steinmeier/Reden/2024/01/230118-OV-Wieler-Cichutek.html | language=de | access-date=18 January 2024}}</ref><ref name="stern.de 2024 a914">{{cite web | title=Bundesverdienstkreuze für früheren RKI-Chef Wieler und ehemaligen PEI-Chef Cichutek | website=stern.de | date=18 January 2024 | url=https://www.stern.de/news/bundesverdienstkreuze-fuer-frueheren-rki-chef-wieler-und-ehemaligen-pei-chef-cichutek-34378122.html | language=de | access-date=18 January 2024}}</ref>
